t: The LAP IP66 weatherproof switch is a robust 1G, 2-way outdoor electrical control solution. It is ideal for gardens, patios, and workshops, providing reliable power switching in exposed environments. The durable polycarbonate construction ensures impact resistance, while the IP66 rating guarantees protection against dust and water ingress. A semi-transparent black cover allows for quick power status checks. Installation is straightforward with captive terminal screws and multiple side and rear knockouts, accommodating various wiring configurations. This 20A switch offers secure and long-lasting performance for demanding outdoor applications.
